raw.question: Reject scoped roots containing mount-runtime segments and serialize resolved background allowlists into child argv
raw.chosen: Reject scoped roots containing mount-runtime segments and serialize resolved background allowlists into child argv
raw.reasoning: The syncer prunes runtime markers anywhere in a remote path, so validation must share that predicate; detached children must consume the parent's validated immutable topology rather than re-reading a mutable paths file or inherited env default.

retrospective.summary: Closed exact-head review gaps by rejecting nested runtime-owned scoped roots and handing detached mounts the parent-validated allowlist instead of mutable paths-file input.
